items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: And he actually was working with Benny Goodman and I sat in and played a set with Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: An excellent musician. A good player. And he actually was working with Benny Goodman and I sat in and played a set with Benny Goodman. So that was nice. Peter was a fine man. He really was a gentleman and when he wanted to he could really play. He was caught up in the theatrics a lot, but down deep he was a really good musician. Good player.
And I see you played with Marian McPartland somewhere along the way.
